name: a-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Aurora style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#0A0A12, #5B2A86, #D64FA8, #FFC2E2). Features: cursor-reactive (ripple). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
